app.title: RotaryCell: Making an unmodified rotary phone work over LTE with an ESP32-S3
app.author: jombib
app.description: Hardware project that allows a standard rotary telephone to connect to LTE networks using an ESP32‑S3 microcontroller.
proposed_tests: Upload firmware to ESP32-S3 via Arduino IDE and verify boot.
Connect rotary phone and test dial tone generation.
Place call to a test number and measure latency between dialing and call connection.
Check packet loss during voice transmission over LTE.
